name: Praj Industries Ltd
title: Praj Industries Ltd - 522205 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PBT before exceptionals collapsed to Rs 15.4m from Rs 582.5m on execution cost overruns and deferred orders; order intake Rs 6,580m is weak, with management guiding FY27 order flow to roughly Rs 800-900 crore a year and no hard capacity discipline.

utilisation.quote: the sites are open. They are not getting completely closed on the basis of the work which we are supposed to do in a time -bound manner.

triggers.label: Q4 order intake Rs 6,580m, weak
triggers.quote: The order intake during the quarter was Rs. 6,580 million with 79% from domestic market
triggers.highlight: order intake during the quarter was Rs. 6,580 million

triggers.label: Rs 300+ crore inquiries deferred
triggers.quote: this was almost Rs. 300 plus crores inquiries which we didnt finalize only because of these issues

triggers.label: Fixed-price contracts moving to flexible pricing
triggers.quote: Earlier, our all contracts used to be 100% fixed price. We have moved from that 100% fixed price to some kind of a flexibility
triggers.highlight: We have moved from that 100% fixed price

triggers.label: Order flow band Rs 800-900 crore
triggers.quote: We should be in that range typically, but as we don't want to give any forward-looking statements
triggers.highlight: We should be in that range typically

guidance.quote: We should be in that range typically, but as we don't want to give any forward-looking statements
the order values can vary from as low as Rs. 50 crores to as high as Rs. 150 crores

red_flags.label: Margin compression for three years
red_flags.quote: we are reducing the margin profits

red_flags.label: Fixed-overhead drag at GenX Rs 10 crore/month
red_flags.quote: the fixed overhead run rate is still continuing at the rate of almost Rs. 10 crores per month

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on order timing and 2G/SAF investment
red_flags.quote: as we don't want to give any forward-looking statements

evasions.quote: I will give you the answer in terms of the qualitative analysis.
Well, yes. We would like to absorb most of the cost and the investments that we have made in GenX.
